info.title: Dev Password
info.description: A command-line tool that allows developers to generate secure, strong passwords to use in projects. Developers can configure how passwords are generated for their purposes.

commands.name: configure
commands.description: Configure various properties of the dev passwords

options.description:

operation: q(uiet),
m(inimal), n(ormal),
d(etailed), and diag(nostic)
